one_sentence: The ten fundamental laws of physics are structurally identical to ten spiritual laws, with the only difference being a consistently placed asymmetry term encoding free will.
executive_summary: This document presents the Master Equation framework of the Theophysics Research Initiative, arguing that the ten fundamental laws of physics (gravity, mass-energy, electromagnetism, strong force, thermodynamics, information, relativity, quantum mechanics, weak force, and coherence) are structurally identical to ten corresponding spiritual laws (grace, meaning, truth, love, moral entropy, Logos, relationship, faith, sin-decay, and Christ). The key evidence is a term-by-term substitution map for each law, showing that the equations are the same with different variable names, plus one consistently placed asymmetry term that encodes agent choice—a degree of freedom physics lacks. The conclusion is that this consistent architecture across all ten laws is not coincidence but design, and that at full integration (Law 10), all asymmetry terms resolve, yielding identity between physical and spiritual coherence.
short_summary: This document is the canonical presentation of the Master Equation framework, which maps ten physical laws to ten spiritual laws via substitution maps. The core structural claim is that the equations are identical except for a single, consistently placed asymmetry term encoding free will. Key evidence includes the unchanged 192π³ denominator in Law 9 and the identical Shannon entropy equation in Law 6. This matters because it provides a mathematically rigorous, verifiable framework for theophysics that is not metaphorical but structural.
